g.text: BY2 | Saved FGO trajectories at GNSS1
All saved dynamic-valid positions; equal metre scales; no rotation, translation, scale fitting or new interpolation.
Oi uses its estimated attitude for GNSS1 transport; gaps and block resets are not connected. Fused reference is not independent truth.
Later engineering diagnostic: 3 new Oi calls, 6 reused Wen/GNC identities. These are not original V3 midpoint trajectories or same-input rankings.
